name: narrativetrace-dotnet
description: Install NarrativeTrace in a .NET project and reach a first trace, diagnose an install that traces nothing, add or verify a Clarity naming report, verify a change by reading what the code actually did, debug a wrong result from its values, explain what an application actually does from a run of it, and report a defect in NarrativeTrace itself with your approval.

interface.longDescription: Install NarrativeTrace in a .NET project and reach a first trace, diagnose an install that traces nothing, add or verify a Clarity naming report, verify a change by reading what the code actually did, debug a wrong result from its values, explain what an application actually does from a run of it, and report a defect in NarrativeTrace itself with your approval. It reads what one run actually did, and needs the .NET SDK and network access for the first package restore.
